An exclusive residence with only 6 units, consisting of two-bedroom and three-bedroom apartments, designed to offer high-quality living, daily comfort, and superior construction performance. Clean architectural lines, bright environments, private outdoor spaces, and innovative construction technologies give rise to a new concept of living: more evolved, more sustainable, more intelligent. HOME 5.1 LOOKS TO THE FUTURE! DISTINCTIVE FEATURES: - HEAVY STEEL STRUCTURE HOME 5.1 is constructed with a heavy steel structure featuring high performance—an advanced building solution that guarantees great solidity, long durability and significant seismic performance. A modern technology offering precision in construction reliability over time and concrete structural value: unlike traditional buildings where materials may degrade or lose value over time; steel maintains its worth as raw material. - NZEB CLASS: NEARLY ZERO ENERGY BUILDING The project is developed according to NZEB (Nearly Zero Energy Building) standards ensuring reduced consumption levels while providing elevated energy efficiency along with maximum housing comfort. Advanced thermal insulation combined with acoustic solutions ensures comfortable living conditions throughout all seasons allowing residents to enjoy their homes sustainably and intelligently. - PRIVATE OUTDOOR SPACES Each unit features terraces and private outdoor spaces conceived as natural extensions of the living area, making them ideal settings for relaxation zones installing bioclimatic pergolas or enjoying moments outdoors with complete privacy & independence from neighbors’ activities . - GUARANTEED ACCESSIBILITY HOME 5.1 has been designed keeping accessibility functional through every phase life might bring forth; a modern elevator eliminates architectural barriers guaranteeing convenience practicality freedom movement everyone irrespective age physical ability can navigate comfortably within this space .
